facts.note: Girard says 'I would not show him mine' at dinner. After dinner he sat alone in the dining room with the brandy, heard the temple strike ten there, and says 'I did not look at my watch.'
'I went out into the street to smoke, at twenty-one minutes past ten by my watch, and I stayed under the front windows of the house.'
'The piano started up in the salon just as I lit my cigar, at twenty-nine minutes past ten by my watch.' The piano line is kept as required.
'At twenty-six minutes to eleven by my watch I heard faint quick bells from the master's window up above.'
'I came back into the house at fourteen minutes to eleven by my watch. The hall clock had just struck eleven, and its face showed two minutes past eleven. I went straight up to Félix in the library.'
